en: A vintage black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a dense medieval town with steeply roofed houses in the foreground and a large Gothic cathedral complex dominating the hill above. The cathedral has two very tall, ornate spires side by side and additional spires and towers around it, attached to a castle-like ensemble of historic buildings and fortifications. The image has slightly irregular white borders, typical of early to mid‑20th‑century postcards. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.
